name: Noble Hierarch

flavor: She protects the sacred groves from blight, drought, and the Unbeholden.
rulings: [{'date': '2020-08-07', 'text': 'If you declare exactly one creature as an attacker, each exalted ability on each permanent you control (including, perhaps, the attacking creature itself) will trigger.'}, {'date': '2020-08-07', 'text': "In a Two-Headed Giant game, a creature “attacks alone” if it's the only creature declared as an attacker by your entire team.
